form.label: L2T - WinEVTX Analysis
form.description: Enhanced analysis of Windows Event Log data from log2timeline output

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | stats count by computer_name | sort computer_name

input.label: Windows Event Source
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ | stats count by winevent_source | sort -count

input.label: Event ID
input.populatingSearch: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=display_name "\\\\(?<winevent_source>[^\\\\]+)\\.evtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | search winevent_source=$winevent_source$ computer_name=$hostFilter$ | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | stats count by event_id | sort -count
